المحاضرة 7 · ورقة مراجعة

الفصل 7: CSS 2 — التخطيط

من float وposition إلى flexbox وgrid والتصميم المتجاوب: كيف ترتب صفحة تعمل على كل شاشة.

01 نظرة عامة

ما موضوع المحاضرة؟

الفصل 7 من Connolly & Hoar: CSS 2: التخطيط. الطرق القديمة (display، float، position ومنها relative وabsolute وسياق التموضع)، ثم flexbox (الحاوية والعناصر، المحوران، justify-content وalign-items، flex-grow/shrink/basis)، ثم grid (fr، repeat، minmax، auto-fill/auto-fit، التموضع بالخطوط، المناطق، الشبكات المتداخلة، الجمع مع flexbox)، ثم التصميم المتجاوب (الهاتف أولًا، viewport، media queries، picture)، والمؤثرات (transform، filter، transition، animation)، وأخيرًا Sass.

Chapter 7 of Connolly & Hoar: CSS 2: Layout. The older approaches (display, float, position including relative, absolute and the positioning context), then flexbox (container and items, the two axes, justify-content and align-items, flex-grow/shrink/basis), then grid (fr, repeat, minmax, auto-fill/auto-fit, line-based placement, areas, nested grids, combining with flexbox), then responsive design (mobile first, viewport, media queries, picture), effects (transform, filter, transition, animation), and finally Sass.

الفكرة الأساسية

استخدم grid لهيكل الصفحة (بعدان) وflexbox لداخل المكونات (بعد واحد)، واجعل الصفحة تستجيب بـ viewport وmedia queries، وأضف الحركة بـ transition وanimation.

Use grid for the page structure (two dimensions) and flexbox inside components (one dimension), make the page respond with the viewport and media queries, and add motion with transition and animation.

قائمة المفاهيم الأساسية

  • float وposition (3–10)
  • سياق التموضع (9)
  • flexbox (11–16)
  • grid الأساسي (17–21)
  • تموضع grid والمناطق (22–27)
  • grid + flexbox (28–29)
  • التجاوب (30–37)
  • المؤثرات (38–45)
  • Sass (46–50)
  • float and position (3–10)
  • Positioning context (9)
  • flexbox (11–16)
  • grid basics (17–21)
  • grid placement and areas (22–27)
  • grid + flexbox (28–29)
  • Responsive (30–37)
  • Effects (38–45)
  • Sass (46–50)

المهارات المكتسبة

  • التمييز بين relative وabsolute وصنع سياق تموضع.
  • بناء صف أو عمود بـ flexbox ومحاذاته.
  • بناء شبكة بـ grid-template-columns/areas.
  • كتابة media queries ووسم viewport.
  • إضافة انتقال أو حركة.
  • قراءة Sass وتوقع CSS الناتج.
  • Tell relative from absolute and build a positioning context.
  • Build and align a row or column with flexbox.
  • Build a grid with grid-template-columns/areas.
  • Write media queries and the viewport tag.
  • Add a transition or animation.
  • Read Sass and predict the resulting CSS.

لماذا يهم؟

كل موقع حديث يعمل على شاشات من 320px إلى 2000px؛ grid وflexbox وmedia queries هي الأدوات التي تجعل ذلك ممكنًا بدون «ترقيع».

Every modern site runs on screens from 320px to 2000px; grid, flexbox and media queries are what make that possible without hacks.

الشريحة 03 — Older Approaches to CSS Layout

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The display property in CSS provides a mechanism for the developer to change an element to block, inline, or inline-block.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The display property in CSS provides a mechanism for the developer to change an element to block, inline, or inline-block.

    display يحول العنصر إلى block أو inline أو inline-block.

    display turns an element into block, inline or inline-block.

  2. (figure) Two-column layout / Three-column layout / Nested column layouts within a column

    تخطيط عمودين، ثلاثة أعمدة، أعمدة متداخلة.

    Two-column, three-column, nested columns.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل يوضح أن الصفحات الحقيقية أعمدة داخل أعمدة؛ هذا ما سنتعلم بناءه.

The figure shows real pages are columns within columns; that's what we'll learn to build.

الخلاصة

display + أعمدة.
display + columns.

الشريحة 04 — Older Approaches to CSS Layout (ii)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Older Approaches to CSS Layout (ii)
  • For the first 20 years of CSS, designers had to “hack” together multi column layouts using floats and/or positioning.
    • There may be times when you may have to support legacy CSS so it makes sense to learn the basics of floats and positioning.
  • Newer approaches (flexbox and grid display modes) make columnar layouts much easier to implement.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. For the first 20 years of CSS, designers had to “hack” together multi column layouts using floats and/or positioning.

    أول 20 سنة: «ترقيع» الأعمدة بـ float وposition.

    First 20 years: “hacking” columns with float and position.

  2. There may be times when you may have to support legacy CSS so it makes sense to learn the basics of floats and positioning.

    تحتاجها لدعم الكود القديم.

    Needed to support legacy code.

  3. Newer approaches (flexbox and grid display modes) make columnar layouts much easier to implement.

    flexbox وgrid أسهل بكثير.

    flexbox and grid are much easier.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

اليوم: grid لهيكل الصفحة، flexbox لداخل المكونات، وfloat فقط لالتفاف النص حول صورة.

Today: grid for page structure, flexbox inside components, float only to wrap text around an image.

الخلاصة

قديم ← حديث.
Old → new.

الشريحة 05 — Floating Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • It is possible to displace an element out of its position in the normal flow via the CSS float property.
  • An element can be floated to the left or floated to the right and content is “reflowed” around the floated element
  • A floated block-level element should have a width specified

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<h1>Float example</h1>
<p>A wonderful serenity has taken ...</p>
<figure>
   <img src="images/828.jpg" alt="..." />
   <figcaption>British Museum</figcaption>
</figure>
<p>When, while the lovely valley ...</p>

figure {
   border: 1pt solid #A8A8A8;
   background-color: #EDEDDD;
   margin: 0;
   padding: 5px;
   width: 150px;
}
/* Notice that a floated block-level element should have a width specified. */
figure { ... width: 150px; float: left; }
figure { ... width: 150px; float: right; margin: 10px; }

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. It is possible to displace an element out of its position in the normal flow via the CSS float property.

    float يخرج العنصر من التدفق الطبيعي.

    float takes an element out of normal flow.

  2. An element can be floated to the left or floated to the right and content is “reflowed” around the floated element

    يطفو يسارًا أو يمينًا والمحتوى يلتف حوله.

    Float left or right; content wraps around.

  3. A floated block-level element should have a width specified

    حدد width للعنصر العائم.

    Give a floated block a width.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

بدون width قد يأخذ العنصر العائم عرض محتواه أو العرض كاملًا فلا يظهر الالتفاف.

Without a width, a floated element may take its content's width or the full width, so no wrap appears.

الخلاصة

float: left | right + width.
float: left | right + width.

الشريحة 06 — Positioning Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The position property is used to specify the type of positioning. The left, right, top, and bottom properties are used to indicate the distance the element will move.
  • absolute The element is removed from normal flow and positioned in relation to its nearest positioned ancestor.
  • relative The element is moved relative to where it would be in the normal flow.
  • static The element is positioned according to the normal flow. This is the default.
  • You can also check fixed and sticky.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The position property is used to specify the type of positioning. The left, right, top, and bottom properties are used to indicate the distance the element will move.

    position نوع التموضع؛ left/right/top/bottom المسافة.

    position sets the type; left/right/top/bottom the distance.

  2. absolute The element is removed from normal flow and positioned in relation to its nearest positioned ancestor.

    absolute: يخرج من التدفق، نسبة لأقرب سلف متموضع.

    absolute: out of flow, relative to the nearest positioned ancestor.

  3. relative The element is moved relative to where it would be in the normal flow.

    relative: يتحرك نسبة لمكانه الطبيعي.

    relative: moves from its normal spot.

  4. static The element is positioned according to the normal flow. This is the default.

    static: الافتراضي.

    static: the default.

  5. You can also check fixed and sticky.

    راجع fixed وsticky.

    Also see fixed and sticky.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

fixed: مثبت بالنسبة للنافذة (لا يتحرك مع التمرير). sticky: عادي حتى يصل لحد معين ثم يلتصق.

fixed: pinned to the window (doesn't scroll). sticky: normal until it reaches a threshold, then sticks.

الخلاصة

static، relative، absolute (+fixed، sticky).
static, relative, absolute (+fixed, sticky).

الشريحة 07 — Relative Positioning

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<p>A wonderful serenity has taken ... </p>
<figure>
   <img src="images/828.jpg" alt="British Museum" />
   <figcaption>British Museum</figcaption>
</figure>
<p>When, while the lovely valley ...

figure {
   border: 1pt solid #A8A8A8;
   background-color: #EDEDDD;
   padding: 5px;
   width: 150px;
   position: relative;
   top: 150px;
   left: 200px;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A figure moved with position: relative; top: 150px; left: 200px — the space it left behind stays empty

    figure مزاح relative 150px لأسفل و200px يمينًا.

    A figure shifted relative 150px down and 200px right.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لاحظ في الشكل: المساحة الأصلية تبقى فارغة، والعنصر المزاح يغطي النص.

Note in the figure: the original space stays empty and the moved element covers the text.

الخلاصة

relative يترك مكانه فارغًا.
relative leaves a hole.

الشريحة 08 — Absolute positioning

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

figure {
   margin: 0;
   border: 1pt solid #A8A8A8;
   background-color: #EDEDDD;
   padding: 5px;
   width: 150px;
   position: absolute;
   top: 150px;
   left: 200px;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) The same figure with position: absolute; top: 150px; left: 200px — the paragraph text closes the gap

    نفس العنصر absolute؛ النص يملأ مكانه.

    Same element absolute; the text fills its place.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الفرق مع الشريحة 7: absolute يخرج من التدفق، فلا يبقى مكان فارغ، ويُقاس من الصفحة (لا يوجد سلف متموضع هنا).

Difference from slide 7: absolute leaves the flow, so no hole remains, and it's measured from the page (no positioned ancestor here).

الخلاصة

absolute لا يترك مكانًا.
absolute leaves no hole.

الشريحة 09 — Overlapping and Hiding Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • One of the more common design tasks with CSS is to place two elements on top of each other, or to selectively hide and display elements.
  • In such a case, relative positioning is used to create the positioning context for a subsequent absolute positioning move.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<figure>
   <img src="images/828.jpg" alt="..." />
   <figcaption>British Museum</figcaption>
</figure>
<p>When, while the lovely valley ...

figure {
   ...
   position: relative;     /* This creates the positioning context. */
}
figcaption {
   ...
   position: absolute;     /* This does the actual move. */
   top: 130px;
   left: 20px;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. One of the more common design tasks with CSS is to place two elements on top of each other, or to selectively hide and display elements.

    مهمة شائعة: وضع عنصر فوق آخر أو إخفاؤه.

    Common task: stack elements or hide them.

  2. In such a case, relative positioning is used to create the positioning context for a subsequent absolute positioning move.

    relative على الأب يصنع «سياق التموضع»، ثم absolute على الابن.

    relative on the parent creates the positioning context, then absolute on the child.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

بدون position: relative على figure، سيُقاس figcaption من الصفحة كلها لا من الصورة.

Without position: relative on figure, figcaption would be measured from the whole page, not the image.

الخلاصة

الأب relative، الابن absolute.
Parent relative, child absolute.

الشريحة 10 — Overlapping and Hiding Elements (ii)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Consider an image that is the same size as the underlying one is placed on top of the other image using absolute positioning.
  • You can hide this image using the display property

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<figure>
   <img src="828.jpg" alt="..." />
   <figcaption>British Museum</figcaption>
   <img src="new-banner.png" class="overlayed" />
</figure>

/* new-banner.png: a "NEW" corner ribbon; the rest is a transparent area */
.overlayed {
   position: absolute;
   top: 10px;
   left: 10px;
}
.hide {
   display: none;
}
/* This is the preferred way to hide: by adding this additional class to the element. */
<img src="new-banner.png" class="overlayed hide" />

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Consider an image that is the same size as the underlying one is placed on top of the other image using absolute positioning.

    صورة شفافة بنفس الحجم فوق الأخرى بـ absolute.

    A same-size transparent image over the other with absolute.

  2. You can hide this image using the display property

    إخفاؤها بـ display.

    Hide it with display.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الطريقة المفضلة: إضافة class اسمه hide بدل تعديل الأنماط. (visibility: hidden يخفي لكن يترك المكان؛ display: none يزيله.)

The preferred way: add a hide class rather than editing styles. (visibility: hidden hides but keeps the space; display: none removes it.)

الخلاصة

display: none.
display: none.

الشريحة 11 — Flexbox Layout

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<div class="media">
   <img class="media-image" src="c.jpg" >
   <div class="media-body">
      <h2>Fall in Calgary</h2>
      <p>Nunc nec fermentum dolor...</p>
      <p>Mauris porta arcu id...</p>
      <p>Phasellus vel felis purus...</p>
   </div>
</div>

/* float approach: margin-left = image size + margin-right */
.media-image { float: left; margin-right: 10px; }
.media-body { margin-left: 160px; }

/* flexbox approach */
.media {
   display: flex;
   align-items: flex-start;
}
.media-image { margin-right: 1em; }

“Prior to flexbox, one would create such a layout within a container using floats plus margins. The problem with this approach is that margins needed to be in pixels and had to exactly match image size. If image size changed (or you wanted same kind of style elsewhere), you had to modify the style.”

“Using flexbox, we now have a much more generalized (and thus reusable) style.”

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A media object (image + text) built first with float and margins, then with display: flex

    كائن وسائط بـ float وهوامش، ثم بـ flex.

    A media object with float and margins, then with flex.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

المشكلة القديمة: margin-left: 160px مربوط بحجم الصورة. flexbox يزيل هذا الرقم.

The old problem: margin-left: 160px is tied to the image size. Flexbox removes that number.

الخلاصة

flex أعم وقابل لإعادة الاستخدام.
flex is general and reusable.

الشريحة 12 — Flex containers and items

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • There are two places in which you will be assigning flexbox properties: the flex container and the flex items within the container.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<div class="container">
   <div>flex item 1</div>
   <span>flex item 2</span>     <- Both block-level and inline elements will become flex items.
   <div>flex item 3</div>
</div>
(flex container; main axis runs left to right, cross axis top to bottom)

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. There are two places in which you will be assigning flexbox properties: the flex container and the flex items within the container.

    مكانان: الحاوية (container) والعناصر (items).

    Two places: the container and the items.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

المحور الرئيسي (main axis) أفقي افتراضيًا، والمحور العرضي (cross axis) عمودي عليه. أي ابن مباشر يصبح flex item حتى لو كان span.

The main axis is horizontal by default; the cross axis is perpendicular. Any direct child becomes a flex item, even a span.

الخلاصة

container + items، main + cross.
container + items, main + cross.

الشريحة 13 — The flexbox container properties

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

display: flex                 Necessary to use flexbox
flex-direction: row           Specifies the direction of the main axis. The default is row.
flex-direction: row-reverse
flex-direction: column
flex-direction: column-reverse
flex-wrap: wrap

الشريحة 17 — Grid Layout

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Grid layout is adjustable, powerful, and, compared to floats, positioning, and even flexbox, is relatively easy to learn and use!

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

   <div>C</div>
   ...
</div>
.container {
   display: grid;
   gap: 10px;     /* To make each cell more visually distinguishable, we have specified a gap,
                     which adds space around each cell. */
}
/* By default, a grid container will behave like any container in that each block element will be
   on its own line (or row). */

الشريحة 20 — Specifying column widths (ii)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

width: 560px;
grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr));
   auto-fill: Fills the row with as many columns as can fit into the container space.
   minmax(100px, 1fr): The min column size is 100px and the max is whatever size is necessary
                       to allow each column to be equal sized.
width: 560px;
grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr));
   auto-fit: Fits the columns into space by expanding the column width into the available container space.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr)) vs repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr)) in a 560px container

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في 560px: خمسة أعمدة بـ 100px على الأقل. الفرق يظهر عندما العناصر أقل من الأعمدة: auto-fill يترك أعمدة فارغة، auto-fit يطوي الفارغة ويمدد الموجودة. هذا أساس شبكة متجاوبة بلا media queries.

In 560px: five columns of at least 100px. The difference shows when items are fewer than columns: auto-fill keeps empty tracks, auto-fit collapses them and stretches the items. This is a responsive grid with no media queries.

auto-fill / auto-fit + minmax.
auto-fill / auto-fit + minmax.

الشريحة 28 — Grid and Flexbox Together

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • grid and flexbox each have their strengths and these strengths can be combined

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

.container {
   display: grid;          /* Grid layout is used to create row and column grid. */
   grid-template-columns: repeat( auto-fill, ... );
}
/* To layout each individual grid cell, we will need to use flexbox. */
.cell {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
}
.cell img {
   align-self: center;
}
.cell h2, .cell p {
   text-align: center;
}
.cell button {
   margin-top: auto;
   justify-self: flex-end;
   align-self: center;
}

    flexbox لمحتوى الخلية.

    flexbox for a cell's content.

الشريحة 30 — Responsive Design

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • In a responsive design, the page “responds” to changes in the browser size that go beyond simple percentage scaling of widths.
  • smaller images will be served and
  • navigation elements will be replaced as the browser window shrinks
  • To make a responsive design you need to:
  • 1. Create a flexible grid (or flexbox) based layout
  • 2. Set viewports via the <meta> tag
  • 3. Customize the CSS for different viewports using media queries
  • 4. Scale images to the viewport size

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

“Notice how some elements are scaled to shrink as browser window reduces in size.” “When browser shrinks below a certain threshold, then layout and navigation elements change as well. In this case, the <ul> list of hyperlinks changes to a <select> and the two-column design changes to one column.”

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. In a responsive design, the page “responds” to changes in the browser size that go beyond simple percentage scaling of widths.

    الصفحة «تستجيب» لحجم المتصفح بأكثر من تغيير النسب.

    The page “responds” to browser size beyond percentage widths.

  2. smaller images will be served and navigation elements will be replaced as the browser window shrinks

    صور أصغر، وتبديل عناصر التنقل.

    Smaller images; navigation is swapped.

  3. To make a responsive design you need to: 1. Create a flexible grid (or flexbox) based layout 2. Set viewports via the <meta> tag 3. Customize the CSS for different viewports using media queries 4. Scale images to the viewport size

    4 خطوات: تخطيط مرن، viewport، media queries، تحجيم الصور.

    4 steps: flexible layout, viewport, media queries, scaled images.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في الشكل: قائمة الروابط <ul> تتحول إلى <select> والتصميم من عمودين إلى عمود واحد.

In the figure: the <ul> of links becomes a <select> and the two-column design becomes one column.

الخلاصة

4 steps to responsive.

الشريحة 31 — Mobile First Design

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • NOTE
  • Mobile-first design suggests that the first step in the design and implementation of a new website should be the design and development of its mobile version (rather than as an afterthought as is often the case).
  • The rationale for the mobile-first approach lies not only in the increasingly larger audience whose principal technology for accessing websites is a smaller device such as a phone or a tablet.
  • Focusing first on the mobile platform also forces the designers and site architects to focus on the the content (for example by eliminating non essential elements).

الشريحة 35 — Media queries in action

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

/* styles.css */
/* CSS rules for phones */
@media only screen and (max-width:480px)
{
   #slider-image { max-width: 100%; }
   #flash-ad { display: none; }
   ...
}
/* CSS rules for tablets */
@media only screen and (min-width: 481px)
   and (max-width: 768px)
{
   ...
}
/* CSS rules for desktops */
@media only screen and (min-width: 769px)
{
   ...
}
/* Instead of having all the rules in a single file, we can put them in separate files
   and add media queries to <link> elements. */
<link rel="stylesheet" href="mobile.css" media="screen and (max-width:480px)" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="tablet.css"
   media="screen and (min-width:481px) and (max-width:768px)" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="desktop.css" media="screen and (min-width:769px)" />

الشرح — جملة بجملة

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشريحة 39 — Transforms

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS transforms provide additional ways to change the size, position, and even the shape of HTML elements.
  • CSS transforms allow you to rotate, skew, transform (move), and scale an element.
  • It is also possible to transform an element in 3D space using the perspective(), rotate3d(), scale3d(), and translate3d() functions

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<figure>
   <img src="700.jpg" alt="...">
   <figcaption>Emirates Stadium</figcaption>
</figure>
figure { padding: 1em; background: #FFCC80; width: 200px; }
figure { transform: rotate(45deg); }   /* Notice that the transform affects all the content within the transformed container. */
figure { transform: skew(-20deg); }
figure img { transform: translatex(100px) translatey(-30px); }   /* You can combine transforms. Notice that the y-axis extends downwards. */
figure { transform: rotate(15deg); }
figure img { transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0.5); }

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  2. CSS transforms allow you to rotate, skew, transform (move), and scale an element.

    rotate، skew، translate، scale.

  3. It is also possible to transform an element in 3D space using the perspective(), rotate3d(), scale3d(), and translate3d() functions

    And 3D: perspective, rotate3d, scale3d, translate3d.

المحور y يتجه لأسفل، لذا translatey(-30px) يرفع العنصر. التحويل لا يغير التخطيط حوله.

الشريحة 41 — Transitions

الشريحة 42 — Transition with example

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The CSS property which will be transitioned.
  • The duration of the transition.
  • The easing function to use, which changes the speed and style of the transition(optional).
  • How long to delay before starting the transition (optional).

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

button {
   background-color: #146d37;               /* This dark green color will be displayed when the mouse is not over the button. */
   transition-property: background-color;   /* 1 Which CSS property of the button is going to be transitioned across time? */
   transition-duration: 0.5s;               /* 2 How long is the transition? The transition will last half a second. */
   transition-timing-function: ease-out;    /* 3 What will be the rate of transition change? It will slow down towards the end. */
   transition-delay: 0s;                    /* 4 Do we delay the start? No delay (transition will start immediately) */
}
button:hover {
   background-color: #60b946;               /* This light green color will be displayed when the mouse hovers over the button. */
}
/* Easing curves shown: linear, ease-out, ease-in */

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. 1. The CSS property which will be transitioned. 2. The duration of the transition. 3. The easing function to use, which changes the speed and style of the transition(optional). 4. How long to delay before starting the transition (optional).

    الخاصية، المدة، دالة التسهيل (اختياري)، التأخير (اختياري).

    Property, duration, easing (optional), delay (optional).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الزر يتغير من أخضر داكن #146d37 إلى فاتح #60b946 خلال 0.5 ثانية مع ease-out (يبطئ في النهاية).

The button fades from dark green #146d37 to light #60b946 over 0.5s with ease-out (slows at the end).

الخلاصة

الاختصار: transition: background-color .5s ease-out 0s.
Shorthand: transition: background-color .5s ease-out 0s.

الشريحة 43 — A sliding menu transition example

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<nav class="menu">
   <p><i class="fa fa-chevron-right"></i></p>
   <ul>
      <li><a href="#">Home</a></li>
      <li><a href="#">Blogs</a></li>
      <li><a href="#">Photos</a></li>
      <li><a href="#">Contact</a></li>
   </ul>
</nav>
.menu {
   position: absolute;
   left: -210px;          /* Menu is initially hidden by being positioned outside the visible area. */
}
.menu:hover {
   left: 0;               /* When the user hovers over the menu, move the left edge of the element to left edge of the browser. */
   transition: left .6s ease-out;   /* Using the transition shorthand property. */
}
.menu {
   transition: left .6s ease-out;   /* The same transition when the mouse is no longer hovering: menu slides back out of sight. */
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A menu hidden at left: -210px slides in to left: 0 on hover, with transition: left .6s ease-out

    قائمة مخفية left: -210px تنزلق إلى 0 عند المرور.

    A menu hidden at left: -210px slides to 0 on hover.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

وضع transition على .menu أيضًا يجعلها تنزلق للخارج بنعومة عند ترك المؤشر.

Putting transition on .menu too makes it slide back out smoothly when the pointer leaves.

الشريحة 44 — Animations

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • An animation alters one or more properties between a start state and an end state (like a transition).
  • Unlike transitions, animations allows designers to control the intermediate steps through keyframe states.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

“A transition alters one or more CSS properties across time. It has a begin state and then it transitions to the end state. It also needs an explicit trigger (such as hovering).”

“An animation also alters one or more CSS properties across time. But you can define keyframes that give you more control over the intermediate steps between the begin and end state.”

“No trigger is needed: an animation begins once it is defined. As well, you can loop an animation.”

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. An animation alters one or more properties between a start state and an end state (like a transition).

    الحركة تغير خصائص بين بداية ونهاية (مثل الانتقال).

    An animation changes properties from start to end (like a transition).

  2. Unlike transitions, animations allows designers to control the intermediate steps through keyframe states.

    لكنها تتحكم بالخطوات الوسطى عبر keyframes.

    But it controls the in-between steps with keyframes.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

من الشكل: الانتقال يحتاج مُحفزًا (مثل hover)؛ الحركة تبدأ بمجرد تعريفها ويمكن تكرارها.

From the figure: a transition needs a trigger (like hover); an animation starts once defined and can loop.

الشريحة 45 — Animation example

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<p class="animated">Animate Me</p>
.animated {
   animation-iteration-count: infinite;    /* Run animation indefinitely. */
   animation-name: bounceIn;               /* Play animation named bounceIn. */
   animation-play-state: running;          /* Play animation once it is defined. */
   animation-duration: 2s;                 /* Animation lasts 2 seconds. */
   animation-timing-function: ease-out;    /* Slow animation towards the end. */
   animation-delay: 1s;                    /* Wait a second before starting animation. */
}
.animated:hover {
   animation-play-state: paused;           /* Pause the animation by hovering over it (useful for debugging). */
}

الشريحة 46 — CSS preprocessors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS preprocessors allow the developer to write CSS that takes advantage of programming ideas such as variables, inheritance, calculations, functions and nesting.
  • CSS itself has many limitations:
    • No variables (prior to 2018).
    • No encapsulation, since every thing is global and there is no scoping rules
    • No modularity (splitting functionality across multiple files, this incurs a time-cost for the user).
    • Duplication, since you set the same properties many times for multiple elements/ classes.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

  2. CSS itself has many limitations:

    حدود CSS:

    لا متغيرات (قبل 2018).

  4. No encapsulation, since every thing is global and there is no scoping rules

  5. No modularity (splitting functionality across multiple files, this incurs a time-cost for the user).

  6. Duplication, since you set the same properties many times for multiple elements/ classes.

الشريحة 50 — Mixins and Functions

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • One of the key limitations of CSS is that even though there is often a lot of repetitive styling, outside the recent CSS variables there is no language feature for eliminating it.
  • Mixins in Sass are like a function that returns a style.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

$mid-neutral : #9AA5B1;
$shadow : 0 0 3px 3px $mid-neutral;
@mixin card() {
   border: solid 1px $mid-neutral;
   margin: 3px;
   box-shadow: $shadow;
}
.box {
   @include card();
   background-color: white;
}
.feature {
   @include card();
}
/* This SCSS will compile into the following CSS. */
.box {
   border: solid 1px #9AA5B1;
   margin: 3px;
   box-shadow: 0 0 3px 3px #9AA5B1;
   background-color: white;
}
.feature {
   border: solid 1px #9AA5B1;
   margin: 3px;
   box-shadow: 0 0 3px 3px #9AA5B1;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  2. Mixins in Sass are like a function that returns a style.

05 ثلاثة مستويات

  • float مثل صورة في مجلة والنص يلتف حولها.
  • relative: تحرك الكرسي لكن مكانه يبقى محجوزًا. absolute: ترفع الكرسي وتضعه في أي مكان والآخرون يملؤون مكانه.
  • flexbox: صف (أو عمود) من الصناديق توزعها كما تريد.
  • grid: ورقة مربعات ترسم عليها الصفحة كلها.
  • التصميم المتجاوب: نفس الملابس تتمدد لتناسب كل جسم.
  • float is like a magazine photo with text wrapping around it.
  • relative: you move the chair but its spot stays reserved. absolute: you lift the chair anywhere and others fill its spot.
  • flexbox: one row (or column) of boxes you distribute as you like.
  • grid: squared paper you draw the whole page on.
  • Responsive design: the same clothes stretch to fit every body.
  • position: static/relative (إزاحة مع حجز المكان)/absolute (خارج التدفق، نسبة لأقرب سلف متموضع)/fixed/sticky؛ سياق التموضع = relative على الأب.
  • flexbox: display:flex؛ flex-direction (main axis)، flex-wrap، justify-content (main)، align-items (cross)؛ العناصر: flex-basis، flex-grow (نسبة توزيع الفائض)، flex-shrink، flex: 1 1 auto.
  • grid: grid-template-columns/rows بـ fr وrepeat() وminmax()؛ auto-fill مقابل auto-fit؛ التموضع بالخطوط (n أعمدة = n+1 خطوط)؛ grid-template-areas + grid-area؛ align/justify-self/items.
  • التجاوب: meta viewport؛ @media بنقاط توقف 480/768؛ progressive enhancement؛ img {max-width:100%} مقابل <picture>.
  • المؤثرات: transform (2D/3D)، filter، transition (property/duration/timing-function/delay)، animation (@keyframes، iteration-count، play-state). Sass: $vars، nesting، @mixin/@include.
  • position: static/relative (offset, space kept)/absolute (out of flow, relative to the nearest positioned ancestor)/fixed/sticky; positioning context = relative on the parent.
  • Flexbox: display:flex; flex-direction (main axis), flex-wrap, justify-content (main), align-items (cross); items: flex-basis, flex-grow (share of the free space), flex-shrink, flex: 1 1 auto.
  • Grid: grid-template-columns/rows with fr, repeat() and minmax(); auto-fill vs auto-fit; line-based placement (n columns = n+1 lines); grid-template-areas + grid-area; align/justify-self/items.
  • Responsive: viewport meta; @media with 480/768 breakpoints; progressive enhancement; img {max-width:100%} vs <picture>.
  • Effects: transform (2D/3D), filter, transition (property/duration/timing-function/delay), animation (@keyframes, iteration-count, play-state). Sass: $vars, nesting, @mixin/@include.
  • float + width.
  • relative يحجز، absolute لا.
  • الأب relative، الابن absolute.
  • flex: justify = رئيسي، align = عرضي.
  • flex: 1 1 auto.
  • grid: 1fr 1fr 1fr.
  • repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr)).
  • الخطوط = الأعمدة + 1.
  • grid-template-areas.
  • meta viewport.
  • @media (max-width:480px).
  • picture: أول source صحيح.
  • transition يحتاج مُحفزًا؛ animation لا.
  • Sass ← CSS.
  • float + width.
  • relative keeps space, absolute doesn't.
  • Parent relative, child absolute.
  • flex: justify = main, align = cross.
  • flex: 1 1 auto.
  • grid: 1fr 1fr 1fr.
  • repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr)).
  • Lines = columns + 1.
  • grid-template-areas.
  • viewport meta.
  • @media (max-width:480px).
  • picture: first true source.
  • transition needs a trigger; animation doesn't.
  • Sass → CSS.

06 اختبار تفاعلي

النتيجة 0/30

    07 نصائح احترافية

    كيف تفهم بدل أن تحفظ

    • افتح أدوات المطور واختر عنصر flex أو grid: Chrome يرسم الخطوط والمحاور فوق الصفحة.
    • لكل تخطيط اسأل: بعد واحد (flex) أم بعدان (grid)؟
    • صغّر النافذة ببطء وراقب متى تعمل كل media query.
    • ارسم grid-template-areas على ورق قبل الكتابة.
    • Open dev tools and select a flex or grid element: Chrome overlays the lines and axes on the page.
    • For each layout ask: one dimension (flex) or two (grid)?
    • Shrink the window slowly and watch when each media query kicks in.
    • Sketch grid-template-areas on paper before writing it.

    تمارين عملية مقترحة

    1. أعد بناء figure مع float يسار ثم يمين (الشريحة 5).
    2. ضع تسمية فوق صورة بسياق تموضع (9).
    3. ابن البطاقات بتذييل في الأسفل (16).
    4. ابن تخطيط Listing 7.2 ثم غيره كما في الشريحة 27.
    5. ابن الجدول الدوري (29) بـ grid.
    6. أضف قائمة منزلقة (43).
    1. Rebuild the figure floated left then right (slide 5).
    2. Put a caption over an image with a positioning context (9).
    3. Build the cards with footers at the bottom (16).
    4. Build Listing 7.2's layout then change it as on slide 27.
    5. Build the periodic table (29) with grid.
    6. Add a sliding menu (43).

    أخطاء شائعة

    • نسيان width مع float.
    • absolute بدون أب relative فيُقاس من الصفحة.
    • الخلط بين justify-content (رئيسي) وalign-items (عرضي).
    • عد الأعمدة بدل الخطوط في grid-column-end.
    • نسيان meta viewport فيصغر الهاتف الصفحة.
    • ظن أن max-width: 100% يقلل حجم التنزيل.
    • استخدام transition بدون تغيير حالة (مُحفز).
    • Forgetting width with float.
    • absolute without a relative parent, so it's measured from the page.
    • Mixing up justify-content (main) and align-items (cross).
    • Counting columns instead of lines in grid-column-end.
    • Forgetting the viewport meta, so phones shrink the page.
    • Thinking max-width: 100% reduces download size.
    • Using a transition with no state change (trigger).
